name: Kǎōu
source:
An alien invader who takes her time invading earth in order to enjoy her life of leisure under the care of the human who provides her with food and a roof over her head in exchange of sex. Lacks common sense and has hard times trying to comprehend human values.

She doesn't need to sleep, but that's what she'll do the most.
